data.bottom_line: A potent storm marks a return of winter and avalanche problems to the Northern Mountains. Heavy precipitation and blowing snow increase avalanche danger throughout the day Saturday. You can trigger a large avalanche in the new snow. The most dangerous slopes are where winds blow snow into thick drifts above weak old snow on north to northeast through east slopes. Travel in or under avalanche terrain is not recommended in the above treeline elevation band. You can find safer travel options in wind-sheltered terrain, at lower elevations, and on slopes less than about 30 degrees steep.
